label: Draft plan: truck days first, tweak anytime
note: Nothing is booked except flights. Truck days (Nov 9-13): everything you need to drive to. No-truck days (Nov 14-16): boat dives, Klein Bonaire and walkable town. No-fly buffer: last dive Sun Nov 15 by about noon, no diving Sun evening onward (18-24 h before the Mon flight).

days.title: Travel day & arrive, pick up truck
items: ~5:00 AM CT leave St. Louis. Likely American via Miami (Monday departure; flights not booked)
Before: pay Entry Tax $75pp + STINAPA nature fee $40pp online
Check in at Carib Inn, pick up the truck
Truck run: big grocery & water stock-up (Van den Tweel / Warehouse) while you have wheels
Easy evening: sunset on the waterfront

days.title: Orientation + central reefs
items: Mandatory orientation/checkout dive + STINAPA briefing
Shore dives (short drive north of town): Bari Reef, Buddy's Reef, Andrea I/II
Afternoon drive: Rincon village + Donkey Sanctuary

days.title: North: Washington Slagbaai park + north sites
items: Early start: Washington Slagbaai National Park (nature fee covers entry; gate entry ends early afternoon)
Shore dives on the way back: 1000 Steps, Karpata, Oil Slick Leap
Option A for Lac Bay night kayak 7-9 PM (not booked yet; ~25 min drive). Thu is the lighter-day pick

days.title: South loop + Lac Bay night kayak
items: Shore dives (south): Salt Pier, Hilma Hooker, Angel City / Alice in Wonderland
South loop drive: salt flats, slave huts, Pekelmeer flamingos, Willemstoren lighthouse
Lac Bay: Sorobon beach afternoon
Mangrove Center night kayak 7-9 PM, 2 adults (NOT BOOKED YET; Wed is the backup). Dark new-moon week = best glow
days.dinner: Hang Out Beachbar or Sebastian's at Lac Bay before the tour

days.title: Light day, return truck (time TBD)
items: Morning: 1-2 easy shore dives (e.g. Bari Reef / Town Pier area) or any site you missed
Truck errands before return: drop extra tanks, souvenir/heavy grocery run, fill up
Return truck: time TBD (check rental paperwork)
Evening: walk to dinner

days.title: Boat dives: Klein Bonaire
items: Carib Inn boat dives 8:30 AM / 1:30 PM: No Name, Ebo's Reef, The Forest
Or water taxi ~$25 round trip for Klein Bonaire snorkel/beach time
Sunset sail (optional)

days.title: Last dive morning + town & spa
items: LAST DIVE: 8:30 AM boat or Carib Inn house reef, out of the water by about noon
No diving from Sun afternoon on (18-24 h before the Mon flight)
Spa: Massage Bonaire ~$90/hr or Smiling Buddha couples Thai massage
Walk the Kralendijk waterfront, souvenirs, return dive gear, pack
days.dinner: Farewell dinner: walkable in town (Bon Tapa, Capriccio or It Rains Fishes area)

days.title: Fly home
items: Check out (taxi to the airport; truck already returned)
Fly home, arrive ~10:05 PM CT
